settings.story: Finding my bean identity changed how I express myself every day. It's more than apparel, it's a personality statement.
I stopped trying to fit in. Now I choose honesty over approval. That's when I realised I'm a Chilli Bean.
Being quiet never meant being empty. I relate to being a Green Bean - mindful and grounded.
Pure, timeless, and unbothered by passing trends. Embracing the Vanilla Bean identity gave me the confidence to celebrate premium simplicity.
Unpredictable, vibrant, and always evolving. Being a Jelly Bean means my style adapts to my creative energy without any rules.
